title: Benchmarking Robust Aggregation in Decentralized Gradient Marketplaces
abstract: arXiv:2509.05833v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Institutions that cannot centralize or sell raw data increasingly exchange model updates instead: cross-silo federated learning is already in production among hospital networks and pharmaceutical consortia. A growing line of research targets the next step: marketplaces in which gradient updates are exchanged as paid, query-specific data products, though none is yet deployed at scale. We formalize this emerging paradigm as a Gradient Data Marketplace (GDM), in which data consumers issue learning tasks and distributed participants contribute query-specific gradient updates. Federated learning asks whether the model survives an attack; a marketplace must also ask who got paid. Existing protocols ensure model-level robustness but fail to capture whether high-quality data is correctly identified and rewarded. translated_title: 去中心化梯度市场中鲁棒聚合的基准测试
translated_abstract: 无法集中化或出售原始数据的机构越来越多地选择交换模型更新：跨机构联邦学习已在医院网络和制药联盟中投入实际生产。一个不断发展的研究方向瞄准了下一步：将梯度更新作为付费的、特定查询的数据产品进行交换的市场，尽管目前尚无大规模部署。我们将这一新兴范式形式化为梯度数据市场（GDM），其中数据消费者发布学习任务，分布式参与者贡献针对特定查询的梯度更新。联邦学习关心的是模型能否在攻击下存活；而市场还必须关心谁获得了报酬。现有协议仅确保模型层面的鲁棒性，却未能捕捉高质量数据是否被正确识别并得到奖励。在GDM中，选择机制决定支付，这会激励参与者为“被选中”而非真正的数据效用进行优化。我们引入了一个……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文形式化了梯度数据市场（GDM）这一新兴范式，指出市场不仅需要模型层面的鲁棒性，还必须确保高质量数据被正确识别和奖励，并针对此提出了鲁棒聚合方法的基准测试。
en_tdlr: This paper formalizes the emerging paradigm of Gradient Data Marketplaces (GDM), highlighting that marketplaces require not only model-level robustness but also correct identification and rewarding of high-quality data, and introduces a benchmark for robust aggregation methods.
